problem: AI coding agents keep producing the same generic-looking designs and lack words for design feedback. Impeccable gives them design commands, reviews and a detector for such patterns.

stack.backend: Rust engine (Cargo workspace) with Node.js tooling and a launcher script
stack.ai: Skill and slash commands for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot and many other agents
stack.deploy: npm package (npx impeccable install) that installs the skill into your agent

whatsNew: It offers 24 named commands like bolder, quieter, critique and audit, plus 62 fixed rules that flag AI-style design tells with no LLM or API key. A PRODUCT.md file records project context for later commands.
